head: b7ee4555810dcb82b4a0714200c599ab076daac8
summary: Maintainers can authorize an agent merge without required checks while retaining other merge gates. The change adds modest maintenance and always-loaded instructions; real-use benefit and complete instruction-growth measurements remain unknown.
reasons: The change addresses #551 directly: maintainers using Ask can tell the agent to merge an approved PR when neither GitHub nor the trusted seam requires checks.
The confirmation excuses only an empty required-check set for the submitted head. Other merge gates remain, and the result records the confirmed head.
Maintenance stays within existing merge, CLI, and setup paths, with no new dependency or setting. The setup warning supports the existing restriction on unattended merges.

The added instruction covers a demonstrated authorization decision that Ruby cannot establish. SKILL.md loads the complete workflow for every task, so the approximately 30 added words impose an unconditional loading cost.

The packet lacks the required instruction-growth report; its estimate does not establish rendered-workflow and other instruction-surface totals. This limits cost evidence but does not demonstrate a material architecture violation.

Three local review rounds produced one fixed risk and three documented nits; two CodeRabbit findings were also fixed. No substantive unresolved finding is identified in the supplied history. Real-use benefit, incident frequency, and time saved remain unknown.
alternative: Keep the bounded confirmation flag. Requiring maintainers to merge on GitHub avoids this maintenance but preserves the reported interruption after agent verification.
next_action: Attach the required instruction-growth report to the existing checkpoint evidence packet before the merge recommendation.
